- [Tekton Chains](https://tekton.dev/docs/chains/) — Tekton controller that records, signs, and stores supply-chain metadata for pipeline task runs.
- [Terraform](https://www.terraform.io) — Infrastructure provisioning tool.
- [Terraform Cloud](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs) — Managed service for Terraform workflows and state management.
- [Terraform MCP Server](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server) — MCP server for Terraform automation and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
- [terraform-aws-eks-operation-scheduler](https://github.com/gianniskt/terraform-aws-eks-operation-scheduler) — Terraform module that schedules AWS EKS node groups to scale up and down with Lambda and EventBridge for cost savings.
- [terraform-docs](https://terraform-docs.io) — Generate documentation from Terraform modules in various output formats.
- [terraform-plugin-docs](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-docs) — Generate and validate Terraform provider/plugin documentation from source.
- [terraform-skill](https://github.com/antonbabenko/terraform-skill) — Claude Code skill for Terraform and OpenTofu best practices, testing, modules, CI/CD, and security.
- [Terragrunt](https://terragrunt.gruntwork.io) — Terraform wrapper for DRY configurations.
- [Terrateam](https://terrateam.io) — GitOps-style Terraform pull-request automation with collaboration features.
- [terravision](https://github.com/patrickchugh/terravision) — Generate professional cloud architecture diagrams automatically from Terraform code (AWS, Google, Azure).
- [Test Kitchen](https://kitchen.ci) — Test infrastructure code on various platforms.
- [Testcontainers](https://github.com/testcontainers) — Libraries for integration tests using disposable containers; OSS core with paid cloud add-ons.
- [Testkube](https://testkube.io) — Kubernetes-native test orchestration platform for running, scheduling, and scaling automated tests across environments.
- [TestRail](https://www.gurock.com/testrail) — Test case management platform.
- [TestRigor](https://testrigor.com) — AI-powered end-to-end testing platform.
- [TFLint](https://github.com/terraform-linters/tflint) — Terraform linter (style + provider-specific rules).
- [The Update Framework](https://theupdateframework.io/) — CNCF framework and specification for securing software update metadata against repository and signing-key compromise.
- [To Be Continuous](https://to-be-continuous.gitlab.io/doc) — Modular GitLab CI template ecosystem for standardizing and accelerating professional pipelines.
- [Travis CI](https://www.travis-ci.com) — CI/CD service for GitHub.
- [Trunk](https://trunk.io/) — Developer workflow platform for code checks, flaky-test management, and merge automation.
- [Upjet](https://github.com/crossplane/upjet) — Code generation and controller runtime for building Crossplane providers from Terraform providers.
- [validate-dependabot](https://github.com/marocchino/validate-dependabot) — GitHub Action that validates `dependabot.yml` against the official Dependabot schema before merge.
- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) — Managed web application platform providing Git-based builds, preview deployments, production hosting, and serverless infrastructure.
- [VictoriaMetrics MCP server](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/mcp-victoriametrics) — Model Context Protocol server that exposes VictoriaMetrics observability operations to compatible AI clients.
- [Vitest](https://vitest.dev) — Blazing fast Vite-native unit testing framework.
- [VoltAgent](https://voltagent.dev) — Open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents.
- [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/) — JavaScript module bundler with code splitting and a plugin-based build pipeline.
- [werf](https://werf.io) — GitOps tool for building and deploying containers.
- [Woodpecker CI](https://woodpecker-ci.org) — CI/CD platform for Git.
- [Xray](https://www.getxray.app) — Test management for Jira (manual + automated tests).
- [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/) — JavaScript package manager with lockfiles, workspaces, and configurable dependency-installation modes.
